title: Component Type, Not Reconstruction Error, Predicts Attention Quantization Sensitivity
abstract: arXiv:2609.26173v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many post-training quantization (PTQ) methods use layer-wise reconstruction, second-order proxy objectives, or activation-aware transformations to reduce quantization-induced error. Whether that error signal predicts the downstream functional impact of quantizing an individual attention projection has not been directly characterized. We sweep nine open-weight language models (1.3B--8B parameters; OPT, GPT-J, LLaMA-1/2/3, Mistral, Qwen 2.5) and quantize one attention projection at a time under round-to-nearest (RTN) and, for seven models, GPTQ at 3 and 4 bits, recording reconstruction error, perplexity change, and per-projection activation-weighted quantization error for 3,808 distinct measurements. We find: (1) within a given component type (Q, K, V, or O), reconstruction error explains less than 10% of the variance in perplexity sensitivity in 27 of 36 cases under RTN, with median R^2 = 0.044; (2) both component type and layer identity

translated_title: 组件类型而非重构误差可预测注意力量化敏感性
translated_abstract: 许多训练后量化（PTQ）方法使用逐层重构、二阶代理目标或激活感知变换来减少量化引入的误差。然而，这种误差信号是否能预测量化单个注意力投影对下游功能的影响，尚未得到直接表征。我们对九个开源权重语言模型（1.3B–8B参数；OPT、GPT-J、LLaMA-1/2/3、Mistral、Qwen 2.5）进行了扫描，在最近舍入（RTN）方法下，以及（对其中七个模型）在GPTQ方法下，以3比特和4比特每次量化一个注意力投影，共记录了3,808次不同测量的重构误差、困惑度变化以及每个投影的激活加权量化误差。我们发现：(1) 在给定组件类型（Q、K、V或O）内部，RTN方法下36个案例中有27个案例的重构误差对困惑度敏感性方差的解释力不足10%，中位R²=0.044；(2) 组件类型与层身份两者……
tldr: 该研究通过对九个语言模型进行3,808次单独量化测量发现，注意力投影的重构误差几乎无法预测量化对困惑度的影响（中位R²仅0.044），而组件类型（Q、K、V、O）才是预测量化敏感性的更可靠指标。
en_tdlr: Through 3,808 single-projection quantization measurements across nine language models, this study shows that reconstruction error poorly predicts quantization-induced perplexity changes in attention projections (median R² = 0.044), while component type (Q, K, V, or O) serves as a far more reliable predictor of quantization sensitivity.
